digest.component_or_area: janitor plan-review gate; recovered RP-02 through RP-06 approval decisions
propositions: Recovered 2026-08-16 approved-but-lossy RP-02 through RP-06 decisions require evidence-backed derisk briefs before implementation stories, mapping architectural intent, hard-won test behavior, and resolving ambiguities.

RP-02 transaction semantics approval: ordered exact-match retirement recovery at explicit live-operation boundary; tombstone is the durable intent; recovery removes live forward/reverse pair only when all three identities exactly agree; ambiguity or replacement failure safety-aborts.

RP-03 approved retry/failure envelope: maximum 3 physical wire invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep per atomic logical operation; compound updates decompose and never replay wholesale; finite-pass fuse opens after 3 consecutive exhausted outcomes across at least 2 tickets.

RP-04 operation-snapshot precedence and configuration composition approved: explicit CLI > environment > project > user > default; per-operation snapshot; separate secret/provider boundary; non-secret subprocess envelope; central defaults; removal of Cloud adapter-local DIG fallback.

RP-05/RP-06 routing and policy decisions approved: normalize all 21 visible advanced verbs to side-effect-free package-data help; comprehensive overview; accepted aliases support help resolution without execution; pre-operation routing does not compose operation snapshot or mount store.
